plan: The four v3 losses all died to a full-HP Water Spout on turn 1 and then to Zapdos plus Zamazenta. This party removes both. Leads Kartana and Gastrodon. Kartana is 348 Speed, faster than Zamazenta (324), Marshadow (297), Zapdos (245) and the 224 lead pair, and Choice Band Leaf Blade is 467-549 into Kyogre's 419 HP through its 252/252 physical bulk - a guaranteed OHKO before Water Spout ever fires. Gastrodon's Storm Drain makes Water Spout literally zero damage and +1 Sp. Atk, and its Ground typing makes Zapdos's Thunder zero as well, so the only Kyogre move that touches the lead pair is a single-target Ice Beam and the only Lucario move that matters is Close Combat into Kartana. If Lucario opens with Follow Me the Leaf Blade is resisted into Lucario instead and Gastrodon still takes nothing: the trade is one turn, not one Pokemon. From turn 2 the plan is all special and almost all non-contact, so Lucario's and Zapdos's Rocky Helmet and Static never collect: Landorus's Sheer Force Earth Power is 2x on Lucario, Zamazenta and Melmetal and ignores Iron Defense entirely because it attacks the 4-EV special side (465 into Zamazenta's 403, 495 into Melmetal's 492), and Landorus is immune to Thunder and resists Body Press and Close Combat. The moment Kyogre is off the field Primordial Sea lifts and Fire comes back exactly as the crack says: Chi-Yu's Beads of Ruin cuts every opposing Sp. Def by a quarter and Life Orb Overheat then OHKOs Zamazenta (764), Melmetal, Lucario, Zapdos (468) and Marshadow, at 328 Speed which is faster than Zamazenta. Heat Wave is the spread copy that Follow Me cannot redirect. Gholdengo is the Ghost the crack asks for: Body Press and Close Combat are zero on it, Heavy Slam and Double Iron Bash are resisted, Water Spout, Ice Beam and Hurricane are resisted, and the whole roster has no Ground and no usable Fire, so its only real threat is Marshadow; Power Gem is 4x on Zapdos, Shadow Ball is 2x on Marshadow and Thunderbolt is 2x on Kyogre. Whimsicott is the Prankster answer to the setup half: Taunt locks Zamazenta out of Iron Defense and Protect, Zapdos out of Tailwind and Roost and Lucario out of Follow Me and Quick Guard; Encore pins a wasted turn; Tailwind beats Zapdos's to the field.
